hotel.name: Hotel Wrenfield
hotel.description: Fictional 140-room boutique hotel in downtown Austin, TX, a few blocks from the I-35 frontage road and Rainey Street. Breakfast buffet included; rooftop pool; valet parking.

planted_story.description: Breakfast buffet breakdown (items running out, long waits, understaffed) rising sharply from week 5, coinciding with festival-season occupancy.
Overnight highway (I-35) construction noise on the freeway-facing side from week 4.
One theft from a room with a door that did not latch.
